repos_data.description: Official MCP server for Scribefy — search YouTube and extract clean, timestamped transcripts in Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client.
Guardrailed video editing MCP server for AI agents. FFmpeg, Hyperframes, repurposing tools, Python client, and CLI. Local, fast, free.
MCP server that fetches YouTube video transcripts and optionally summarizes them.
Self-hosted YouTube downloader (web UI for youtube-dl / yt-dlp)

repo_meta_data.description: An MCP server (stdio + HTTP/SSE) that fetches video transcripts/subtitles via yt-dlp, with pagination for large responses. Supports YouTube, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Vimeo, Facebook, Bilibili, VK, Dailymotion. Whisper fallback — transcribes audio when subtitles are unavailable (local or OpenAI API). Works with Cursor and other MCP host
